layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Spinosaurus webbed foot morphology
features: A large, three-toed clay foot with a smaller fourth toe (hallux) touching the ground
Thin, flexible clay membranes (webbing) connecting the long, flat toes
Toes tipped with blunt, friendly-looking dark clay claws
Tactile 'squishy' texture on the webbing, slightly translucent
The foot is pressing down into a small patch of soft clay mud to show the 'spread'
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot of the webbed foot. The lighting is warm and highlights the texture of the webbing. The rest of the leg fades into a soft blur. No text.
